title: Want to Go to Main Stacks?
body: UC Berkeley students love studying in Main Stacks! You are working with Catherine on constructing a confidence interval for the mean number of hours students spend in Main Stacks each year. To do this, you take a random sample of $$400$$ UC Berkeley students and record how many hours each student spent studying in Main Stacks over the past year. Then, you compute the mean number of hours for your sample; it is $$170$$ hours. You also calculate the standard deviation of your sample to be $$10$$ hours.
